skills.name: TEAM FOUNDATION
skills.description: At the start of each round, for every {1} Karasuno player on your side, DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner) gains {2} stack(s) of the [Fly] Buff, each stack increasing his Power ATK by {3} and Receive stat by {4}, up to {5} stacks. Whenever a player on your side touches the ball, each stack of [Fly] increases their Basic Stats by {6}% for {7} net crossings.

skills.name: EXPLOSIVE SPIKE
skills.description: DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner) performs a Power Spike with power equal to {1}% of his Power ATK stat. Each stack of [Fly] increases the power of this spike by {2}% of his Power ATK stat. If this spike is Critical, the power of your side's next spike increases by {3}% of the spiker's corresponding stat.

skills.name: CAPTAIN'S ENCOURAGEMENT
skills.description:
Whenever a player on your side touches the ball, each stack of [Fly] increases their Basic Stats by {1}% for {2} net crossings.
When [Fly] stacks are at least {3}, your players' ATK Technique and DEF Technique increase by {4}%.
When [Fly] stacks are at least {5}, the maximum cooldown of your players' Ultimates are reduced by {6} net crossings.
Whenever a player on your side performs a Critical ball touch, they recover {7} Stamina.
Whenever your team scores, your players recover {8} Stamina.

skills.name: STABLE RECEIVE
skills.description: DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner) performs a Receive with power equal to {1}% of his Receive stat. Each stack of [Fly] increases the power of this Receive by {2}% of his Receive stat. If the number of [Fly] stacks is more than {3}, this Receive is guaranteed to be Critical.

When [Fly] stacks are at least {0}, your players' ATK Technique and DEF Technique additionally increase by {1}%. At the start of each round, if there are at least {2} Karasuno players on your side, DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner) gains {3} stack(s) of [Fly], each stack increasing his Power ATK stat by {4} and Receive stat by {5}, up to {6} stacks.

When [Fly] stacks are at least {0}, if a Karasuno player consumes a buff through their own player skill to boost their stat, they regain {1} stack of the buff. Whenever DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner) performs a Critical play, the power of your players' next spike increases by {2}%.

bonds.name: School Banner
bonds.description: When the number of [Connect] stacks is greater than [Fly] stacks, DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner)'s [Fly] stacks becomes {0}; when the number of [Fly] stacks is greater than [Connect] stacks, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner)'s [Connect] stacks becomes {1}.
